applies_to: accepted links of a limosat_trajectory_link_qc_v2_20260907 release (scientific edge Parquet)
decision_unit: one drift vector between consecutive keypoints within a v2 QC trajectory
neighbour_model: v2 neighbour model unchanged for R1: accepted links of the exact same source/target image pair, leave-one-out, up to 24 neighbours within 30 km, at least 8, robust distance-weighted local affine with the v2 prediction guard; single pass. Support and neighbour counts use the same accepted links of the pair.

exclusions.R1: local fit supported, local_residual_m > residual_floor_m, coherence_ratio >= coherence_min, n_corroborating == 0 (direct or interpolated endpoints)
exclusions.LAND: start or end point >= land_margin_km inside land on the supplied inland-distance raster
exclusions.COASTAL: start or end point inside land by more than 0 and less than land_margin_km
exclusions.OPEN_WATER: SIC < open_water_sic at both endpoints (each endpoint on its own date, nearest cell); links with no SIC value at either endpoint are kept
exclusions.INTERP_UNSUPPORTED: an endpoint interpolated, and fewer than support_min of the support_nearest nearest other links within support_radius_m, or the link more than support_tolerance_m from their median displacement

flags.bit_0_PAIR_INCOHERENT: image pair with >= incoherent_min_links links of which >= incoherent_fraction have coarse_residual_m > incoherent_residual_m
flags.bit_1_FEW_NEIGHBOURS: fewer than few_neighbours_min other links within few_neighbours_radius_m (kept; reviewer judged such links mostly valid)

sic_products.asi: University of Bremen AMSR2 ASI v5.4, 3.125 km daily Arctic GeoTIFF (default)
sic_products.nsidc: NOAA/NSIDC Climate Data Record v6, 25 km daily

split_semantics.rows_deleted: excluded links are removed from the edge table and listed with reason codes in the exclusion table
split_semantics.rule: a kept link starts a new segment after every excluded link of its v2 trajectory; flags never split
split_semantics.new_ids: segment 0 keeps qc_trajectory_id; later segments get deterministic integers above the period's maximum qc_trajectory_id, ordered by (qc_trajectory_id, excluded-link start time)
split_semantics.unchanged_columns: all v2 columns, including is_last, stopped and converged_to, are carried unchanged and describe the v2 trajectory

evidence.r1: held-out reviewer labels, SAR image check 2015-2025, buoys, ELoFTR (limosat-papers rogue-vector review)
evidence.interp_unsupported: sensitivity sweep against ELoFTR (March 2020) and same-keypoint rerun disagreement (May-July 2024); chosen setting cuts links > 2 km off from 6.4% to 1.4% and 3.4% to 0.46%
evidence.filter_review: reviewer verdicts on 24 SAR tiles: R1, land, coastal and open-water steps judged correct in 27 of 28 verdicts; 0-1 neighbour links judged valid in 7 of 7

checks: edge_uid unique and disjoint between kept and excluded
zero continuity violations within v3 trajectories
